summary:
Main
Iron ore showed selective price recovery today. The seaborne 61% and 65% indices rose to USD 90.35 and106.70/dmt, all 12 brands gained, and the Domestic Ore Composite Index reached 800.72 yuan/mt. However, DCE most-traded closed at 669.5 yuan/mt, down 0.22% from the previous close; the 61% and 58% port indices each fell 1 yuan while the 65% held steady.
